responsibility: This header materializes the Rust frontend's target-hook data structures from `rust-target.def`. It expands the hook macros into the `gcc_targetrustm` structure of function pointers, declares the shared `targetrustm` instance supplied by each target, and exposes `rust_add_target_info` so target hook implementations can register CPU and OS properties consumed by the frontend's target-option and cfg setup.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete header-side expansion of the rust-target interface: it includes rust-target.def under DEFHOOK/HOOKSTRUCT macros to turn the hook list into the gcc_targetrustm function-pointer struct and extern declarations, whereas rust-target.def only specifies the hook inventory and metadata.
